inst the same expectation, so it is not a self-test of the source: the source's own agreement with that expectation at the same pixels is the pixel-bridge record (scripts/check_m3_pixel_bridge.py), and the source's object screen motion is the mask-centroid arbiter (scripts/check_m3_mask_centroid.py).

Outside-mask criterion (reviewer 2026-10-11): a guided run's outside-mask magnitude lies between the paired A0's and the source's, and the median cosine between its outside tracks and the source's outside tracks (same grid, both visible, source displacement >= 0.25 patch) is >= 0.8; grade 'source' in the same invocation.

Paired criteria (reviewer 2026-10-10): a guided run is read against the A0 of the SAME seed and length: its object track survival must not be below the paired A0's (an A0 that loses every track says nothing about guidance); its tile peak must lie within the A0-to-source range (grade 'source' alongside); its background displacement must move more than 0.5 patch from the A0 value toward the expected one.

Reading: background displacement is the camera the model chose (expected = the source camera through the bridge of record on the lifted background); the object centroid is where it moved the object (expected = the retargeted path); deformation is the median spread of object tracks about their centroid in object sizes, which separates 'the model moved the object' from 'the model distorted it'. A guided run is graded with the same columns; the claim rule applies.
